---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

screen_time <- read_csv("screen_time.csv")
```
```{r}
screen_time_clean <- screen_time |>
  mutate(
    day_type = if_else(
      day %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday"),
      "Weekend",
      "Weekday"
    )
  )

screen_time_clean |>
  group_by(day_type) |>
  summarise(
    avg_screen_time = mean(total_screen_mins),
    avg_pickups = mean(pickups),
    avg_notifications = mean(notifications)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(screen_time, aes(x = notifications, y = pickups, color = total_screen_mins)
) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#6A3D9A",
    linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#D8C8F0", high = "#5B2A86") +
  labs(
    title = "How Are Notifications Related to My Phone Pickups?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Days with more notifications tend to have more pickups, but days\n",
      "with fewer pickups can still have longer screen time."),
    x = "Notifications",
    y = "Pickups",
    color = "Screen Time (min)",
    caption = paste0(
      "By: Doreen Li, Created on: 11/07/2026, Source: Personal iPhone Screen Time Data\n",
      "Screen time, pickups, and notifications were recorded daily from Oct 11 to Oct 24."
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      hjust = 0,
      color = "#7F7F7F"
    )
  )
```
